# Confluence

A tool for team collaboration and knowledge management.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/confluence/.

## Actions

- **Add Content Label**: Add labels to a piece of content.
- **Create Blogpost**: Create a new confluence blog post.
- **Create Page**: Create a new confluence page in a specified space.
- **Create Page Property**: Create a property on a confluence page.
- **Create Private Space**: Create a private confluence space.
- **Create Space**: Create a new confluence space.
- **Delete Page**: Delete a confluence page.
- **Get Attachment Labels** (read-only): List labels on an attachment.
- **Get Attachments** (read-only): Retrieve attachments of a confluence page.
- **Get Audit Logs** (read-only): Retrieve confluence audit records.
- **Get Blog Posts** (read-only): Retrieve a list of blog posts.
- **Get Blog Posts For Label** (read-only): List all blog posts under a specific label.
- **Get Blogpost by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a specific confluence blog post by its id.
- **Get Blogpost Labels** (read-only): Retrieve labels of a specific confluence blog post by id.
- **Get Blogpost Like Count** (read-only): Get like count for a confluence blog post.
- **Get Blogpost Version Details** (read-only): Retrieve details for a specific version of a blog post.
- **Get Blogpost Versions** (read-only): Retrieve all versions of a specific blog post.
- **Get Blogposts** (read-only): Retrieve a list of blog posts.
- **Get Child Pages** (read-only): List all direct child pages of a given confluence page.
- **Get Labels** (read-only): Retrieve all labels in a confluence site.
- **Get Labels for Space** (read-only): List labels on a space.
- **Get Labels for Space Content** (read-only): List labels on all content in a space.
- **Get Page by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a confluence page by its id.
- **Get Page Labels** (read-only): Retrieve labels of a specific confluence page by id.
- **Get Page Like Count** (read-only): Get like count for a confluence page.
- **Get Page Versions** (read-only): Retrieve all versions of a specific confluence page.
- **Get Pages** (read-only): Retrieve a list of pages.
- **Get Space by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a confluence space by its id.
- **Get Space by ID** (read-only): Retrieve a confluence space by its id.
- **Get Space Contents** (read-only): Retrieve content in a confluence space.
- **Get Spaces** (read-only): Retrieve a list of confluence spaces.
- **Update Blogpost**: Update a confluence blog post's title or content.
- **Update Page**: Update an existing confluence page.
- **Create Blogpost Property**: Create a property on a specified blog post.
- **Create Space Property**: Create a new property on a confluence space.
- **Create Whiteboard**: Create a new confluence whiteboard.
- **Create Whiteboard Property**: Create a new content property on a whiteboard.
- **Delete Blogpost Property**: Delete a blog post property.
- **Delete Page Content Property**: Delete a content property from a page by property id.
- **Delete Space**: Delete a confluence space by its key.
- **Delete Space Property**: Delete a space property.
- **Delete Whiteboard Content Property**: Delete a content property from a whiteboard by property id.
- **Get Anonymous User** (read-only): Retrieve information about the anonymous user.
- **Get Blog Post Content Properties** (read-only): Retrieve all content properties on a blog post.
- **Get Blogpost Operations** (read-only): Retrieve permitted operations for a confluence blog post.
- **Get Content Restrictions** (read-only): Retrieve restrictions on a confluence content item.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Get information about the currently authenticated user.
- **Get Inline Comments for Blog Post** (read-only): Retrieve inline comments for a confluence blog post.
- **Get Page Ancestors** (read-only): Retrieve all ancestors for a given confluence page by its id.
- **Get Page Content Properties** (read-only): Retrieve all content properties on a page.
- **Get Space Properties** (read-only): Get properties of a confluence space.
- **Search Content** (read-only): Searches for content by filtering pages from the confluence v2 api with intelligent ranking.
- **Search Users** (read-only): Searches for users using user-specific queries from the confluence query language (cql).
- **Update Blogpost Property**: Update a property of a specified blog post.
- **Update Page Content Property**: Update a content property on a confluence page.
- **Update Space Property**: Update a space property.
- **Update Whiteboard Content Property**: Update a content property on a whiteboard.
